description: Name rules on a writable copy of the empty ACCDB. For each of a fixed list of table names (ASCII case pair Tbl/TBL, accented, precomposed and decomposed e-acute, upper-case E-acute, trailing and leading space, '.', '!', brackets, backquote, apostrophe, 64 and 65 characters) CreateTableDef(name) + one Long field + TableDefs.Append is called and the appended TableDef's Name read back. Then TableDefs (after Refresh) is enumerated, a fixed list of differently spelled names is looked up through TableDefs.Item, a column-name case pair (a, A) and an index-name case pair (ix1, IX1) are tried through DDL, QueryDefs named Tbl (same as a table), qcase and QCASE are created, and MSysObjects is read. Each call's outcome and returned spelling are recorded.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
